result.stdout:
Command-line tool for generating OIP modules.

Usage:
  oip <name> [options]
  oip --name Report [options]

Options:
  --name <name>              Module name. Prompted when omitted.
  --project <path>           Path to the target ASP.NET project file.
                             Discovered in the current directory when omitted.
  --angular-project <value>  Angular project name from angular.json or path to
                             the Angular project directory. Discovered from
                             SpaRoot, SpaProxyServerUrl and SpaProxyLaunchCommand
                             when omitted.
  --force                    Overwrite generated files when they already exist.
  -h, --help                 Show command usage.

Examples:
  oip Report
  oip --name Report --project src/Oip.Rtds/Oip.Rtds.csproj --angular-project oip-rtds
